recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-12319 unless a future PA or terminology decision changes the Encounter Reason value set scope.
issue_request: FHIR-12319 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for the DSTU2 Appointment-related Encounter Reason value set. It requested adding SNOMED CT 243796009 |Situation with explicit context| and 272379006 |Event| descendants so encounter or appointment reasons could include family-history-like concerns and events.
initial_application: Git commit ded82404f278de42d61f8d402d832a8bc4e0e412, "GF#12319 - Broadening Value Set Encounter Reason Codes", added two SNOMED CT compose includes to source/encounter/valueset-encounter-reason.xml for concept is-a 243796009 and concept is-a 272379006. No other Jira-tagged source application was found.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Encounter and Appointment as active resources, and current Encounter.reason and Appointment.reason both bind to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/encounter-reason. Targeted Jira searches found no later directly relevant final issue changing this request; Zulip and Confluence searches found no substantive conflicting community record beyond tracker/commit bot notifications.
reconciliation: No source change was needed because source/encounter/valueset-encounter-reason.xml still includes both requested SNOMED CT filters in the authoritative current value set source.
